historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity and EPS CAGRs are NOT computed -- both series are dominated by structural breaks (FY2022 demerger one-off gain of 6,894.3; FY2024 impairment of 1,531.6 that took shareholders' equity from 2,659.1 to 1,246.9 in one year) and would be actively misleading as growth proxies. Revenue CAGR (continuing ops only, FY2023-FY2026, 2.7%) is used as the sole anchor -- consistent with the Analysis JSON's framing of TAH as a structurally challenged incumbent, not a compounder. This is a deliberate deviation from the standard 'equity CAGR primary' rule, justified by the demerger/impairment noise exactly as documented for BAP.AX and BSL.AX in MEMORY.md.

scenario_narratives.base: National Tote and retail-model reforms deliver modest structural margin gains; digital share loss continues but decelerates; revenue grows near GDP-plus; margin matures at 18% over a decade; cash tax normalises to 30% as loss carryforwards exhaust; BetMakers excluded from the base case pending completion.
scenario_narratives.bull: BetMakers completes and delivers guided synergies plus a B2B growth engine; National Tote and licence exclusivity claw back digital share; margin matures at 22%; AUSTRAC resolves without material fine.
scenario_narratives.bear: Digital share loss to corporate bookmakers continues unabated, advertising caps (Jan-2027) bite hardest on the weaker digital challenger, AUSTRAC produces a material fine, BetMakers disappoints or fails to complete; margin compresses to mid-14s%, below FY26.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Tabcorp is valued as a structurally challenged incumbent wagering/media operator using a 10-year owner-FCF component DCF, NOT a growth extrapolation. The FY2022 Lottery Corporation demerger and FY2018 Tatts merger are treated as structural breaks excluded from CAGR history; FY2023-FY2026 continuing-operations revenue (2.7% CAGR) anchors growth, and margins are built up from FY26's 'before significant items' EBITDA (431.7m, 16.4%) rather than any single statutory year distorted by impairments (FY2024: -1,531.6m) or one-off gains (FY2022: +6,894.3m demerger gain). Cash tax, near-zero in FY25-26 on impairment-year loss carryforwards, is explicitly ramped to the 30% AU statutory rate -- the single largest normalisation in the model, since FY26's true owner FCF is materially flattered by the near-zero cash tax rate. Leases are treated as debt (Treatment A) because the company's own reported net-debt figure already includes lease liabilities. A 12x terminal cap (below the house 20x default) reflects that this is a turnaround, not a compounder -- consistent with the skill's guidance to use a lower cap for cyclical/structurally slower businesses.
key_risks_to_valuation: AUSTRAC enforcement investigation (disclosed May 2026) is unresolved; a material fine/remediation cost (echoing the 2017 $45m precedent) is not separately reserved in any scenario and would be an incremental bear-case drag

Continued digital wagering share loss to Sportsbet, Entain and bet365 -- TAB's digital share has structurally declined and there is no clear catalyst for reversal beyond National Tote and licence exclusivity, both unproven at scale

BetMakers acquisition (~A$267m EV) is unclosed -- ACCC and multi-jurisdiction gaming/racing regulatory approval risk, integration risk, and financing-mix uncertainty; excluded from base case, credited only in bull
January-2027 federal gambling advertising caps constrain customer acquisition industry-wide just as TAB is trying to rebuild digital share against better-funded rivals
FY27 dividends guided unlikely to be franked -- reduces the after-tax yield support under the current low, low-payout dividend
Terminal value is a meaningful share of enterprise value on a still-recovering margin base -- see terminal_pct_of_value per scenario

sanity_check_notes.status: trips on P/E after two fix passes; override documented, not a third distortion
sanity_check_notes.fix_pass_1: WACC raised 9.5% -> 10.5% (wacc_too_low candidate, regulatory single-point-of-failure risk). Implied P/E fell 74.2x -> 68.4x. Did not clear (threshold ~56.2x = 2x historical avg 28.1x).
sanity_check_notes.fix_pass_2: Base growth trimmed (2.0-2.5% path -> 1.5-2.0% path; terminal growth 2.5% -> 2.0%) (growth_too_high candidate). Implied P/E fell 68.4x -> 65.5x. Did not clear.
sanity_check_notes.why_no_third_pass: Base terminal value is already Gordon-bound essentially AT the 12x cap (tv_gordon==tv_cap==3848.4 in the FY26 build) with an implied terminal EV/EBITDA of 6.7x -- in line with, not above, the 10yr historical average of 6.95x. A further terminal-value cut would not move the P/E multiple materially, because the trip is arithmetic: FY26 statutory NPAT (46.3m) is a trough figure (near-zero cash tax on FY23/24 impairment-year loss carryforwards, plus ~44.3m/yr of Victorian Licence amortisation inside D&A), and ANY reasonable going-concern equity value divided by that thin base produces a triple-digit-adjacent P/E. The checker has no trough-earnings candidate (only peak_fcf, which looks the other direction) so it cannot see this. The EV/EBITDA implied multiple (7.6x) sits close to the historical average (6.95x) and did NOT independently trip -- corroborating that the DCF value is reasonable on a cash-flow basis even though the P/E ratio built on GAAP statutory earnings is not informative for this name this year.
sanity_check_notes.residual_trip: Implied P/E 65.5x vs 2x-average threshold ~56.2x (10yr avg 28.1x, itself distorted by the FY2022 demerger-gain P/E of 0.33x and several null/undefined years). judgment: SHIP with this documented override rather than force a third distortion (further WACC/growth/cap cuts) purely to clear a ratio the checker cannot contextualise for a post-impairment, loss-carryforward-driven trough-earnings turnaround.

inputs.sbc_source: core_metrics FY2026 stock_based_comp (AUD millions); cash-flow-statement add-back, immaterial (~0.26% of revenue), no separate equity-award tax line disclosed
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-25T04:53:15Z regular close (Yahoo Finance chart API); 52-week range 0.66-1.19
inputs.wacc_rationale: AUD flows, AUD quote -- single-currency build, no FX adjustment needed. 10.5% WACC (raised from an initial 9.5% after sanity_check.py flagged wacc_too_low against the regulatory single-point-of-failure risk in the qualitative analysis -- AUSTRAC enforcement investigation live since May-2026 with a 2017 m penalty precedent, and licence-dependent revenue): ~4.3% AU 10yr risk-free (Sep-2026) + ~6.2pp premium for structural competitive pressure from corporate bookmakers, the AUSTRAC regulatory tail risk, and a leveraged (1.2x reported, up to 1.6x pro forma post-BetMakers) turnaround balance sheet. Held at ONE rate across all three scenarios -- risk is charged in the flows via scenario weighting (30% bear), not stacked again as a differential bear-case WACC (section 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A) -- leases as debt. Company's own reported net debt definition is explicit: 'gross debt...including lease liabilities, less cash' (FY26 annual report note, gearing ratio disclosure). net_debt=533.1 reconciles to total_debt(716.3)+lease_liabilities(115.7)-cash(305.8)=526.2, within rounding/FX-swap noise of the reported 533.1. Flows therefore use STATUTORY EBITDA/EBIT (no lease principal or interest deducted a second time) and total_debt in the bridge is grossed up to 832.0 (=716.3 borrowings + 115.7 lease liabilities) so total_debt-cash=net_debt ties exactly to the reported figure.
inputs.nci_treatment: No material NCI -- TAH.AX has no minority-interest structure in its consolidated statements (wholly-owned Wagering & Media and Integrity Services segments); not applicable.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing table -- operating company, non-US/cyclical row) with the adaptations file's lease and risk-charged-once rules applied. FY2022 is the demerger year (TLC.AX spun off May-2022): revenue AND net income both structurally break at that boundary (FY2022 net income of 6,775.9 is a one-off 6,894.3 gain on demerger of discontinued ops; continuing ops actually lost 118.4 that year per kpis.NetIncomeContinuing). core_metrics revenue from FY2022 onward is ALREADY continuing-operations-only (2,373.3 in FY22 vs 5,686 in FY21) -- no separate revenue_continuing column exists in this ticker's kpis table, so the raw revenue column is used unmodified from FY2022 forward, and FY2021-and-earlier is excluded from CAGR/margin history as a structural break (same treatment as the FY2018 Tatts merger, which roughly tripled the balance sheet 3.7bn->12.9bn and predates the demerger). FY2024 EBITDA (169.8 statutory) reflects a 1,531.6 impairment; FY2020 similarly absorbed a large impairment -- both addback-adjusted implicitly by anchoring the margin build to FY26's 'before significant items' EBITDA (431.7, 16.4% margin) rather than any single statutory year. Cash tax paid was near-zero in FY25 (1.3) and FY26 (2.9) on carried-forward tax losses from the FY23/FY24 impairment years -- NOT a sustainable base rate; ramped to the 30% AU corporate statutory rate over 4 years in the base case (see cash_tax_rate_path). Net debt is POSITIVE (533.1m), so no interest-income strip is needed (net cash > 1x FCF base rule does not apply; the reverse is true -- TAH pays net interest). The pending BetMakers Technology Group acquisition (~A$267m EV, announced 10-Aug-2026, targeted completion 3Q FY27, subject to ACCC and multi-jurisdiction regulatory approval) is NOT baked into the base-case balance sheet or share count -- it is unclosed, its financing terms (cash/scrip mix) are not yet finalised, and EPS accretion is not guided until FY2028-29. It is treated qualitatively in the bull case narrative only, consistent with 'genuine non-SBC issuance must be modelled explicitly' -- there is no explicit issuance to model yet. 10-year horizon used because margins are still recovering from a multi-year trough (FY23/FY24 net losses) and the cash tax rate has not yet normalized -- a 5-year horizon would capitalize an immature, still-near-zero-tax margin in perpetuity.

bear.narrative: Bear case: digital share loss to Sportsbet/Entain/bet365 continues unabated, National Tote slips or underdelivers on liquidity gains, and the January-2027 gambling-advertising caps disproportionately hurt TAB's ability to defend or rebuild digital share versus better-capitalised corporate bookmakers. AUSTRAC enforcement produces a material fine and remediation cost burden echoing the 2017 $45m precedent (modelled as margin drag, not a one-off subtraction, since timing/quantum are unknown). BetMakers either does not complete or completes and drags on returns through integration cost overruns without delivering guided synergies. Revenue is flat-to-declining for several years before a modest late-cycle stabilisation; EBITDA margin compresses back toward the mid-14s%, below even the FY26 level, as retail channel decline outpaces cost discipline.

base.narrative: Base case: National Tote (Spring 2026) and retail commercial model phase two (1-Jul-2026) deliver modest structural margin gains as guided, but corporate-bookmaker share loss in digital continues to cap top-line growth near GDP-plus. EBITDA margin recovers from the FY26 16.4% (before significant items) toward an 18% mature level over a decade -- well short of the pre-competition mid-20s% margins TAH earned as monopoly totalizator operator, reflecting that the competitive erosion is structural, not cyclical. Cash tax ramps to the 30% statutory rate as FY23/24 impairment-year tax losses are exhausted. BetMakers is NOT assumed to complete in the base case (regulatory/ACCC risk, integration risk); if it does, run-rate synergies are a bull-case upside, not a base assumption. [Fix pass 2, sanity_check.py: base growth trimmed from a 2.0-2.5% path to a 1.5-2.0% path and terminal growth from 2.5% to 2.0% after the checker flagged growth_too_high against a checker-computed 1.9% through-cycle revenue CAGR. Note that checker CAGR spans FY2016-FY2026, crossing BOTH the FY2018 Tatts merger (tripled the balance sheet) and the FY2022 TLC demerger (removed Lotteries/Keno revenue) -- a blended figure across two structural breaks that the checker cannot see, analogous to the documented BAP.AX/BSL.AX cases. The trim is applied anyway as the second fix-priority pass because it is directionally conservative and does not materially change the qualitative story.]

bull.narrative: Bull case: BetMakers completes on schedule (3Q FY27) and delivers the guided $30m run-rate synergies plus a genuine global B2B wagering-technology growth engine; National Tote materially improves pool liquidity and odds, clawing back digital share from Sportsbet/Entain/bet365; the reformed Victorian licence (to 2044) and NSW/SA retail exclusivity underpin durable pricing power; AUSTRAC investigation resolves without a material fine. EBITDA margin recovers toward 22% (still well below the pre-2018 legacy monopoly margins, reflecting that competitive dynamics have permanently changed even in the bull case) and revenue growth holds in the mid-single digits as digital share stabilises rather than continuing to erode.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear weight raised above the 15% house default to 30%: TAH carries a live, unresolved AUSTRAC enforcement investigation with a 2017 $45m precedent, an unproven multi-year digital-share turnaround against better-capitalised corporate bookmakers, and a pending debt-funded-leverage-increasing acquisition (BetMakers, pro forma leverage 1.6x) with real integration and regulatory-approval risk -- several independent things must go right simultaneously for the base case, closer to the going-concern/customer-concentration bear-weight trigger than a typical mature industrial. Bull weight trimmed to 25% because it requires BOTH BetMakers completing AND delivering synergies AND National Tote succeeding AND digital share stabilising -- a genuine multi-legged bull case per section 3's guidance to trim bull weight when several independent things must go right. Base retains the plurality at 45% as the single most likely single path (modest, guided structural reform, no acquisition credit, tax normalisation).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
